notes.title: The (Late) Anniversary Update! (v1.1.3)
notes.notes:
That's right, It's our anniversary! (2 weeks ago, but let's ignore that) 

It's been a little over 6 years since we've launched on Steam. Thanks for all of the support throughout the years!

We got a little update for you to celebrate. Without further ado:

[h1]v1.1.3 Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*] Menu music has been updated with a catchy new track by Jano Manzali! The track has also been added to the official soundtrack (which is available to purchase if you're interested)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/817330/AT_SUNDOWN_SitD_Soundtrack/

[*] Characters from our Alpha have been added as unlockables. They're a bit weird ːdawnlolː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28365215/f476772cae2f8fde4cf7ab7d5a7c6997f07d7b75.png[/img]

[*] Changed the executable icon to be of Dawn rather than the sunset. 
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the player spotlight in online play to improve visibility.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28365215/068a08bddd1998980652767fbac3f86fe36fd7c1.png[/img]

[*] Added the HUD in Challenges so you can see ammo and cooldowns like in normal gameplay.
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed lights on Disco Main Stage disappearing on lower graphical settings. 
[*] Fixed being able to go out of bounds in Lab Generators. Collisions should be improved on the map in general.
[*] Fixed the game checking for achievements related to online that don't exist (they will come back soon!)
[/list]

Finally, thanks to everyone who played the game at MAGFest! We had a lot of fun seeing people enjoy the game with their friends. Hope to see you around in online play and our Discord community ːdawnsmileː

Cheers,
Ted

notes.title: v1.1.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[u]Patch Notes:[/u]
[list]
[*] Upgraded the Unity engine, so there should be some performance improvements... and maybe some new bugs
[*] Updated builds for Intel-based Macs and Linux/SteamOS
[*] Re-enabled switching characters and weapons in the online lobby
[/list]

[u]Known Bugs:[/u]
[list]
[*] The lobby host's character doesn't show up correctly in the lobby until the game starts
[*] Switching from playing an online game to a local one might mess with the local game's options
[/list]

notes.title: The Rifts in Time and Space Update (v1.0.5) for At Sundown: SitD is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32939734/09bf35763b9cf6d24f52983a1433029100498da9.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone! We are pleased to announce that our first big update, [i]The Rifts in Time and Space[/i], is OUT NOW!

This update features new time traveler costumes for each of the characters, new Lab maps that feature portals that teleport you across the map, and the biggest change - being able to see where you are on the map in an online match.

Enjoy! Let us know your thoughts on the Discord: [url=https://www.discord.gg/atsundown]https://www.discord.gg/atsundown[/url]

[b]New Content[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Added 3 new Lab maps[/b]
[*] [b]Added 4 new unlockable “Time Traveler” skins, 1 for each character[/b]
[*] [b]Added unlockable “Random Weapon on Spawn” game option[/b]
[/list]

[b]Quality of Life Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]When playing online, your controlled player(s) will be visible to you with a spotlight[/b]
[*] Spawn particles are now bigger
[*] All level walls are now brighter to help with visibility
[*] Unlock order has been changed - game modes like Capture the Flag and King of the Hill are unlocked much earlier
[*] Unlocking levels is faster - each level takes about 3 matches
[*] Unlocks now show the level required
[/list]

[b]Balance Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Online non-controlled players no longer have spotlights on them on spawn
[*] Giant Claymore total # of swings reduced to 2
[*] Giant Claymore reload time increased from 3s to 4s
[/list]

[b]Bug-fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Game Options scroll bar going back up to the beginning after changing an option
[*] Fixed scroll bars in Profile Stats dropdowns moving slow
[*] Fixed Steam username not showing up on the unlock screen for local matches
[*] Fixed Action Cam focusing on dead bodies
[*] Fixed player death indicators staying on screen on Action Cam
[*] Fixed Action Cam going into the stage on “Main Reactor” Reactor map for non-host players
[/list]

[b]Other Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Disabled “Swordmaster” game mode temporarily for re-evaluation
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v.1.0.4 Released
notes.notes:
[b]New Beta Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Starting up the game while you are part of the Discord server and have Discord open now gives you the “Players” role in the Discord server.
[*] Steam players will get the “Steam Players” role
[*] While you have the game running, you’ll have the “Now Playing” role.
[*] #looking-for-players will now be restricted to Players only.
[*] Added some more options in Options - “Graphics Detail”, “Visual Effects”, “Blood” and “Dead Bodies”
[/list]
[b]Quality-of-Life Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] “Dynamic Camera” game setting renamed to “Action Cam”
[*] Description made clearer
[*] “Same Weapon Between Players” game setting renamed to “All Players Same Weapon”
[*] If the game doesn’t connect with Discord, the game will try to connect with Discord again every 60 seconds.
[/list]
[b]Bug-fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed certain players being able to see everyone on the map
[*] Fixed Steam players not being able to play online with other Steam/Discord players.
[*] Fixed Reactor “meltdown” phases not ending
[*] Adjusted ambient lighting in Mansion maps “Attic” and “Study” to be more visible.
[*] Adjusted ambient lighting in Reactor maps to be consistent.
[/list]

Thanks for the positive reception so far! Feel free to post any bugs/feedback in the official Discord: [url=https://www.discord.gg/atsundown]discord.gg/atsundown[/url]

-Ted

notes.title: First Update - February 16th 2018
notes.notes:
First off, thanks for everyone who checked out the demo this past week! The reception has been great 😊 Keep spreading the good word and tell your friends about it!

With the feedback that was posted, we were able to find and fix previously undetected bugs, and change aspects that were confusing to players.

And now, the patch notes:
[list]
[*]Fixed players being stuck in sprint in online play.
[*]Fixed “Back” text overlapping with the button prompt in credits on certain resolutions.
[*]Fixed SMG being visible on top of walls.
[*]Button prompts now only cycle if two or more local players have joined a party with different input options. Otherwise they display the prompts for the last pressed input.
[*]Player 1 now has to manually press the join button (C on keyboard, Y on Xbox, Triangle on Dualshock) to join an online party in quick play or in custom match. This was done to reduce confusion on how to change input from keyboard/mouse to controller and vice versa. (Just a heads up, once you’re in game and there are no other local players you can switch between k/m and controller freely) 
[/list]

These changes will be carried on to the full release, so thanks for making At Sundown a better game for everyone! If you find any more bugs, you can reach us on the Steam community or on any one of these channels:
[list]
[*]Discord: discord.gg/atsundown
[*]Twitter: twitter.com/SundownGame
[*]Facebook: facebook.com/SundownGame
[/list]
Cheers,
Mild Beast Games

notes.title: December Update
notes.notes:
Hello All

We're making great strides on the game and we're on track for our early 2018 release but wanted to share some news and info about where things are at this point. 

We're to the point in development now where the game is essentially feature complete so we're in the fine tuning stage for most of the game. Over the past several months we've added in lots of new content we haven't shown to the public and those features are all coming together nicely. 

We've also updated all of our in-game graphics to make things look a little better. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28365215/79fd28813fa38c2a669e75a27e475ba35d821208.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28365215/2f06e95757827cf2a48da96d14cab74b2730237e.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28365215/7241d28617d7af03b5008c4d6fb2ca385b18623c.png[/img]

Thank you all for being awesome fans and we are looking forward to giving you At Sundown early next year! 

Happy Holidays!
